This valuation sits above the 28.3 average recorded at quarter-ends over the last twelve fiscal quarters, excluding readings above 100. Investors paying this premium may be betting that the company will continue to add guests and keep more of each booking as profit. If Airbnb does both, would the business be worth more than buyers pay today.
news.title_zh: 市場是否低估了 Airbnb 股價？
news.summary_zh: Airbnb (ABNB) 股票交易價格為其盈餘的 38.3 times，該盈餘涵蓋至財政 Q2 2026 的四個季度。此估值高於過去十二個財政季度季底記錄的 28.3 平均值，不含高於 100 的讀數。支付此溢價的投資者可能押注公司將持續增加房客並保留更多每筆訂單的利潤。若 Airbnb 兩者兼顧，該企業價值是否會高於買方今日支付的價格。

news.title: Should You Buy Airbnb Stock For Its Cash?
news.summary: Over the last twelve months, Airbnb (ABNB) generated free cash flow equal to 5.1% of its market value, outpacing the 4.5% median for companies in the S&P 500. A yield above the typical company's can send a mixed signal. It suggests either the stock is undervalued relative to the cash it generates, or investors anticipate a shrinking business. So what would you actually own if you bought Airbnb for its cash.
news.title_zh: 你應該為了現金買入 Airbnb 股票嗎？
news.summary_zh: 過去十二個月，Airbnb (ABNB) 產生的自由現金流等於其市值的 5.1%，超過 S&P 500 中公司的 4.5% 中位數。高於典型公司的殖利率可能發出混合訊號。這暗示股票相對於其產生的現金被低估，或投資者預期業務萎縮。所以如果你為了現金買入 Airbnb，你實際上會擁有什麼。
